name: We Met v8.7.0 In-Page Checkout and Social Feed
changes: Launches Razorpay Standard Web Checkout directly from the wallet with Razorpay.open() and no checkout-page navigation
Keeps the wallet visible behind Checkout and verifies successful payments on the backend before adding talk time
Adds a full-screen vertically scrollable customer post feed with caption and like controls
Adds a full-screen listener-owned post feed with like totals, liker lists, and three-dot edit/delete actions
Adds SMS OTP sign-in for returning customers and listeners
Replaces administrator-approved password recovery with a single-use SMS OTP reset flow
Removes password-reset navigation and reset controls from the admin portal
Uses one clean pink focus border without the old outer glow across editable fields
Shares duplicated brand assets and replaces sixty avatar files with generated in-app avatars
Consolidates the test suite so the complete GitHub-safe project contains exactly 95 files
